Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger

Class IrcProtocol

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.messenger.IrcProtocol
All Implemented Interfaces:
MessengerProtocol
public class IrcProtocol extends Object implements MessengerProtocol
The native, in-process IRC backend: a complete RFC 2812 client over a plain or TLS socket, with no third-party dependency. It handles registration (PASS/NICK/USER), nickname-in-use recovery, server PING keep-alive and dead-link detection, PRIVMSG/NOTICE (including CTCP ACTION/VERSION/PING/TIME), JOIN/PART/QUIT/NICK/TOPIC, the 001 welcome, 353 name replies and 376 end-of-MOTD, optional NickServ IDENTIFY, and automatic reconnect with backoff.

Security: with useTls the socket is an SSLSocket from the default SSLSocketFactory, so certificates are validated against the JDK trust store; passwords are held in memory only (see AccountConfig) and are never logged.

All listener callbacks fire on the reader thread; the UI marshals to the EDT. sendRaw(String) and the send helpers are thread-safe.
